outline:
The course aims at expanding students’ understanding on the overall concept of the contemporary western architecture development, which concerns with the context of culture, environment and society.
此課程目的在於擴展學生對當前建築思潮的瞭解，其與文化、環境和社會涵構有關
schedule:
1. Architecture and Symbol ---Barthes, Roland. ”The Eiffel Tower.” VIA 2 (1973): 160-68.
2. The Paradox of Contemporary Architecture... Cook, Peter, and Neil Spiller, eds. The Paradox of Contemporary Architecture. London:
Academy Press, 2001.
3. Questions of Perception...Holl, Steven, Juhani Pallasmaa, and Alberto Perez-Gomez. Questions of Perception. San
Francisco: William Stout, 2006.
4. The culture of Congestion... Koolhaas, Rem. Delerious New York. London: Monacelli, 1997 (1978).
5. The Architecture of the City...Rossi, Aldo. The Architecture of the City. Translated by Diane Ghirardo and Joan
Ockman, Oppositions Books. Cambridge, MA: MIT Press, 1982.
6. Collage City...Rowe, Colin, and Fred Koetter. Collage City. Cambridge, MA: MIT Press, 1978.
7. Space, Movement and Event...Tschumi, Bernard. Architecture and Disjunction. Cambridge Mass: MIT Press, 1996.
8. Complexity and Contradiction...Venturi, Robert. Complexity and Contradiction in Architecture. 2nd ed. NY: Museum of
Modern Art, 2002.
———. Learning from Las Vegas - Revised Edition: The Forgotten Symbolism of
Architectural Form. Cambridge, MA: MIT Press, 1977.
9.Critical Regionalism
10.Deconstructivism
11.High-tech architecture
12.Digital architecture
